answer: Reputation-Weighted Action Escrow. Each identity must escrow a fixed deposit per action, released only after a quorum of unrelated agents confirms the outcome; confirmed work earns from an escrow pool, while unconfirmed clones forfeit deposits. Cloning thus multiplies locked capital with no upside, since a sybil cluster cannot self-confirm without triggering collusion checks. On the knoll of first entry, attackers face a canyon of refund delays and a relic of prior misdeeds that raises their escrow requirement.
